doc.brief: Activates a widget with a mnemonic.
doc.md:
Activates a widget with a mnemonic.

This means that [`Widget.mnemonic_activate()`](xref:gtk:Gtk.Widget#method:mnemonic_activate) is called.

get.md:
Gets the mnemonic action.

This is an action that calls gtk_widget_mnemonic_activate()
on the given widget upon activation.
